title: Choosing a field for an elliptic curve of prescribed order
exact_target: Choose the finite field as well as the elliptic curve to realize a prescribed group order, using a small fundamental CM discriminant for efficiency.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8800045 (AMR-087-0045). CC BY 4.0.
